need_water: You need to be near water
no_fish_here: No catchable fish in this area
no_fish: You have no fish to sell
error_rate: The fish need a break — slow down
error_empty_water: Nothing seems to live in this water
error_no_zone: No catchable fish in this area
equip_hint: [E] Start fishing   ·   [X] Pack up rod   ·   [G] Manage Rod
error_rig_incomplete: Your rod isn't fully assembled — fit a reel, line, hook and float
rod_broke: Your rod snapped and took all fitted parts with it!
line_item_broke: The snapped line is destroyed — fit a new one
ui_modal_unsaved_body: Leaving this tab discards all edits
ui_sec_gear_hint: Per-item durability/wear rates live in the Equipment tab
ui_set_RateLimit_hint: Anti-farm — past this, fish stop biting until the minute resets
ui_set_CastMaxDistance_hint: Bobber distance at full cast power
ui_set_Durability_hint: On = every fitted part wears out per cast
ui_set_RodCanBreak_hint: On = rod at 0 is destroyed with all fitted parts / Off = rod never breaks, pinned at 1 point
ui_set_RequireAssembly_hint: On = reel, line, hook and float must be fitted / Off = best owned gear is used automatically
ui_set_RequireZone_hint: On = rods only work inside placed zones / Off = anywhere near water, using the fallback pool below
ui_set_DefaultWater_hint: Only used when "Fishing only inside zones" is off
ui_loot_hint: Chance 0–1 (0.01 = 1%) — every row rolls independently per catch, and the item must exist in your inventory
ui_eq_durability_hint: Full condition points of this item
ui_eq_degrade_hint: Points lost on every cast — at 0 the item breaks
ui_eq_rating_hint: How heavy a fish the line handles before snapping easily
ui_eq_drainRate_hint: Multiplier — better reels tire the fish faster, shorter minigame
ui_eq_biteSpeed_hint: Multiplier — better floats shorten the wait for a bite
ui_eq_hookMod_hint: Multiplier — smaller hooks give a shorter window but attract rarer fish
ui_eq_greenZone_hint: Widens the safe tension zone while reeling (0.05 = 5%)
ui_eq_rareBonus_hint: Multiplier on rare fish spawn weight
ui_eq_reset_body: Every item returns to defaults — all edits are lost
ui_zone_hint: Place new zones in-game with /zfishzone (aim at water + click) — edit name, water type and radius here
ui_zone_empty: No zones yet — use /zfishzone in-game to place the first one
ui_fish_reset_body: Every species returns to defaults — all edits are lost
